ios.desc:
Grind Finer helps you get the best from your grind by turning your shot history into smart grinder suggestions. Log your shots, and the app learns your setup so you spend less time chasing the right setting and more time enjoying great coffee.

How grinder predictions work

Grind Finer uses your own shot data to suggest grinder settings. When you log shots with your beans, grinder, machine, and basket, the app learns what works for your equipment. When you start a new shot with the same setup, it predicts a grinder setting based on your past successful extractions.

The prediction uses:

Your equipment – Grinder, machine, and basket
Your beans – Which coffee you’re using
Your targets – Desired brew time and ratio (e.g. 1:2 espresso)
The more shots you log, the better the suggestions. Using consistent names for your grinder, machine, and basket helps the app learn your setup and improve predictions over time.

Features

• Shot logging – Record beans, grinder setting, dose, yield, brew time, temperature, and tasting notes
• Grinder setting predictions – Suggested settings based on your shot history
• One-tap suggestions – Accept predicted values with a single tap while logging
• Shot journal – Filter and review past shots
• Equipment management – Manage beans, grinders, machines, and baskets in one place
• Popular equipment presets – Quick setup for common machines and grinders

Who it’s for

Whether you use a Gaggia Classic, Rancilio Silvia, Niche Zero, DF64, or any other setup, Grind Finer adapts to your gear. Log your shots, use the predictions as a starting point, and refine from there.

quotes.text:
On a related note, I have been working on an app that helps determine the correct grinder setting when dialing in espresso. After logging two shots with the same setup (grinder, coffeee machine, basket etc), it then uses machine learning (and some other stuff that I am still improving) to predict the correct setting for your grinder based on the machine temperature, the weight of the shot etc.

https://apps.apple.com/ph/app/grind-finer-app/id6760079211

Its far from perfect when it comes to predictions right now but I expect to have massive improvements over the coming weeks. For now it works ok as an espresso log at least.

I'm hoping after a few tweaks I can save people a lot of wasted coffee!
